definitions.explanation: A building where students or workers live together; communal housing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寮|りょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live in a university dormitory.

examples.japanese: {寮|りょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: The meals at the dormitory are cheap.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧{寮|りょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I moved into the company dormitory.

notes:
USAGE: {寮|りょう} refers to communal living quarters, typically for students or employees.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧{寮|りょう} (student dormitory)
- ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧{寮|りょう} (company dormitory)
- {寮|りょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to move into a dorm)
- {寮|りょう}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (dorm life)
- {寮|りょう}⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (dormitory fees)

NOTE: Different from ⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧ (hotel) or ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧ (Japanese inn) which are for temporary stays.
